tools.name: prevailing-wage_search
tools.description: Search Davis-Bacon wage determinations by state, county, construction type, or award/bid date. Results include source details and an indicator when a record may be out of date. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/prevailing-wage/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: prevailing-wage_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an active determination by state, county, construction type, and award/bid date. Unmatched determinations are not inferred. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/prevailing-wage/resolve. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: prevailing-wage_classification-rates
tools.description: Return sourced base/fringe rates, notes, zones, and excerpts for a wage determination. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/prevailing-wage/classification-rates. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: prevailing-wage_classification-validate
tools.description: Use deterministic keyword matching against a selected wage determination. Ambiguous work is routed for human conformance review. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/prevailing-wage/classification-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: prevailing-wage_conformance-draft
tools.description: Prepare optional SF-1444 request language from caller-supplied facts. Human review and contracting-officer submission are required; this is not an approved classification or rate. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/prevailing-wage/conformance-draft. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does

tools.name: prevailing-wage_payroll-precheck
tools.description: Run deterministic DBRA checks against a wage determination. This is a compliance precheck, not a certified government filing. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/prevailing-wage/payroll-precheck. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: prevailing-wage_fringe-reconcile
tools.description: Compare annualized benefit contributions and cash-in-lieu with the supplied required hourly fringe. Inputs and findings are returned for review. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/prevailing-wage/fringe-reconcile. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: prevailing-wage_payroll-report
tools.description: Generate an editable XLSX and a minimal PDF summary after DBRA precheck. Output is not a prescribed government form. Price $0.08 USDC. POST /api/v1/prevailing-wage/payroll-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "prevailing-wage" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prevailing-wage_search · Private data: prevailing-wage_search · Public sink: prevailing-wage_search, prevailing-wage_resolve, prevailing-wage_classification-rates, prevailing-wage_classification-validate, prevailing-wage_conformance-draft, prevailing-wage_payroll-precheck, prevailing-wage_fringe-reconcile, prevailing-wage_payroll-report · Destructive: prevailing-wage_search, prevailing-wage_resolve, prevailing-wage_classification-rates, prevailing-wage_classification-validate, prevailing-wage_conformance-draft, prevailing-wage_payroll-precheck, prevailing-wage_fringe-reconcile, prevailing-wage_payroll-report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prevailing-wage_search · Private data: prevailing-wage_search · Public sink: prevailing-wage_search, prevailing-wage_resolve, prevailing-wage_classification-rates, prevailing-wage_classification-validate, prevailing-wage_conformance-draft, prevailing-wage_payroll-precheck, prevailing-wage_fringe-reconcile, prevailing-wage_payroll-report · Destructive: prevailing-wage_search, prevailing-wage_resolve, prevailing-wage_classification-rates, prevailing-wage_classification-validate, prevailing-wage_conformance-draft, prevailing-wage_payroll-precheck, prevailing-wage_fringe-reconcile, prevailing-wage_payroll-report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
